title: IndexedDB Persistence
description: Use IndexedDB for large-scale cache persistence in React Query applications.

data.text: IndexedDB is a low-level API for client-side storage of significant amounts of structured data. Unlike localStorage, it is asynchronous, supports transactions, and can store much larger datasets—often hundreds of megabytes or more. For React Query apps with large caches, IndexedDB is the right choice.
React Query provides an async persister for IndexedDB through the `@tanstack/query-async-storage-persister` package. It uses `idb-keyval` or similar libraries under the hood.

data.title: IndexedDB persistence setup

data.text: IndexedDB persistence is asynchronous, which means the app may render before hydration completes. Show a loading state or stale data during this period.
data.title: Async Hydration
IndexedDB Persistence Key Points
points: IndexedDB handles large datasets better than localStorage.
Use for apps with significant cached data.
Consider fallback to localStorage for older browsers.
data.takeaway: IndexedDB persistence enables rich offline experiences for data-intensive applications.
